授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項:
Practically, this course will address the development of industries, companies and regions in Asia. The course consists of the following topics: (1) The rise and decline of companies and industrial sectors in Asian countries/economies. The case studies of the semiconductor industry in Taiwan, Japan, and China will be explained in detail. (2) Other topics including startup ecosystems, multinational corporations, industrial clusters, and so on (Determined by the situation).
In the first 10 or so classes, the lecturers will explain semiconductor companies/industries in Asia (Taiwan, Japan, China), and several other topics related to industrial development/corporate strategy/regional development in Asia.  In the last several classes, students will be required to present their own case studies (basically, one case by one student) and to discuss these topics.  Each student can choose any topic related to industrial development/corporate strategy/regional development in Asian countries/economies (for example, the business model of Samsung; the development of the Taiwanese healthcare industry; the rise of startup ecosystem in Shenzhen, and so on).   In this way, we can share many case studies.
Grading is mainly based on presentation and discussion.
